loops.name: Ask a research question
loops.blurb: The front door. A founder question becomes a Mission and a Task for the Research Director.

loops.name: Create a Task
loops.blurb: A Task is written to the Kernel and shown on the canvas.

loops.name: Assign and reassign
loops.blurb: Move a Task to a seat. The agent path notifies the seat; the human path is where delivery has failed before.

loops.name: Spawn a seat
loops.blurb: Start a runtime the operator can watch: a PTY, then an agent session on top of it.

loops.name: Steer and cancel
loops.blurb: Interrupt work in flight without losing the record of it.

loops.name: Review and publish
loops.blurb: The governed critic path. R15 shipped on this, and R16 renders it.

loops.name: Show the research world
loops.blurb: Everything R16 must reveal on the canvas: the ledger, the task surface, artifacts, events and cables.

loops.name: Close the app
loops.blurb: Quit must stop every worker it started. This loop is made of lifetime wires, not IPC.
